children: Argan reported record second-quarter fiscal 2027 results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenues of $383.98 million and net income of $53.30 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $70.03 million and diluted earnings per share were $3.76 for the quarter. The company also reported cash, cash equivalents and investments of $1.028 billion and no debt as of July 31, 2026.
Adjusted EBITDA (quarter): $70,030 thousand; Adjusted EBITDA margin: 18.2%.
Power segment growth: Power revenue grew 53% year-over-year to $301 million in the quarter, driven by ramp-up of construction activities on multiple contracts.
Project milestones: Final completion achieved on the remaining Midwest Solar and Battery Projects following the quarter close.
Industrial segment progress: Construction of a new fabrication facility continues on schedule with expected completion next quarter to support vessel fabrication demand for data centers.

Teledata expansion: Closed acquisition of ValCor Communications, expanding geographic presence and adding installation and repair services for information, communication, and data networks, including defense, aerospace, and technology clients in the region.
Balance sheet and liquidity: Cash, cash equivalents and investments totaled $1.028 billion; net liquidity (working capital) was $440.36 million and the company reported no debt.
